purpose: The real 2025-26 coaching staffs for the replayed season (betting-odds test, real-stat report and other save-less replay tools). The replay rates them with the same staff model a new save uses (sim.replay_staff_stints).

rating_rules.head_coach: The game's own rule for a real head coach in a new save: the team's starting head-coach slot (gameplay_staff_slots) calibrated once to the coach's reputation grade (staff.apply_head_coach_reputation). Grades come from staff.HEAD_COACH_REPUTATION_GRADES (a soft calibration from published 2025-26 coach rankings). A coach without a grade there carries an explicit grade below with its reason.
rating_rules.coordinators: The team's starting offensive and defensive coordinator slots, exactly as a new save starts them. Teams do not publish coordinator titles consistently and the game has no evidence-based ratings for assistants, so none are rated individually. Lead assistants named by a public source are recorded for reference only.
rating_rules.not_tuned: No grade here was chosen or adjusted by looking at the betting test or the real-stat report.

stint_rule: Each head coach runs from first_game_date (inclusive; null = opening night) until the next coach's first_game_date. Dates are the schedule's local game dates.

james borrego.reason: Interim from 2025-11-15. No 2025-26 ranking includes him (he was an assistant when they were published), and the game's grade table has no entry. Rated at the game's neutral point (grade 60 = three stars on every head-coach rating, no effect either way), the same grade the table gives Tiago Splitter, the season's other in-season interim. His earlier Charlotte record (2018-22, below .500, no playoffs) is weak but four seasons old and with thin rosters, so it was not used to move him off neutral.
